clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the jungle of Stranglethorn Vale, an attempt is made to preserve the young troll Yenniku. With the youth caught in a trance, a prepared soul gem is brought forth to capture his spirit.

Following the effort to save Yenniku, you stand face to face with the young troll in Stranglethorn Vale. His mind is lost, caught entirely in another place while he remains motionless before you. The only path forward involves the enchanted gem prepared specifically to hold his essence.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yenniku stands stunned before you, his mind in another place...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the Soul Gem upon his forehead. He shudders as his soul is sucked in, leaving his body, a mindless husk, behind.
